title: Separate venue custody, external transfer rails, internal lending and stablecoin circulation

decisions.rule: Record network support at the specific venue. Issuer deployment on a chain does not imply every exchange supports that chain for deposits or withdrawals.
Product eligibility is not actual utilization. Never infer XRP borrowable supply, demand or market impact without outstanding balances, rates and counterparty/usage data.
Do not count account-only stablecoin balances as public-chain circulating supply or settlement volume until external transfer is enabled and verified.
